model.name: Laurel
model.area_source: A-0.0 project data 'S.F. OF PROPOSED ADU: 460 S.F.'; A-1.0 LIGHT & VENTILATION 'STUDIO: 460 S.F.'

storeys.source: A-2.0 front, rear and side elevations: one floor, F.F. to T.P. only

model.note: Sacramento County Permit Ready ADU, Model A1 "Laurel": the studio plan, 460 sf, one shed roof. Its front is -z in this file, the opposite of the barn cabin. The exterior is stucco; the fibre-cement lap siding the sheet also offers arrives with #133.

note: Runtime material swaps. Each option sets baseColorFactor on the named materials; Laurel ships no textures yet (#133).

views.label: Show interior
views.desc: Roof off — look down into the rooms. Laurel has no ceiling objects to hide: the ceilings ARE the roof underside, because every wall runs to it.

views.label: Cutaway
views.desc: Dollhouse with the front wall and its skin removed, for a sectional look through the entry.

views.label: Interior only
views.desc: Partitions and slab alone, with the openings left in so the doors read.

views_note: Visibility modes for the viewer's SHOW INTERIOR control. Each lists the glTF node names to HIDE; show everything else. Node names, not prefixes, so no string matching is needed and a mode that matches nothing fails the export instead of the page.

main_body.note: the heated box, face of stud to face of stud (A-1.0)

overall.note: over the roof: 1'-6" at each end, 5'-0" over the entry and 1'-6" at the rear

dimensions.note: TWO FOOTPRINTS. `main_body` is the building; `overall` is what the roof covers, with the 5'-0" overhang over the entry. A setback check needs both, since many jurisdictions measure to the wall and cap eave projection separately.
